notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on 1930, 1958 and the 1979 removal. The FFLA Facebook post on this site was seen only as a search snippet and could not be read; that snippet says the cabin was also torn down in 1979, which conflicts with firelookout.com's header (1930-1958 for the cabin era). Not used. A geocache listing (GC6MB2D) mentions remains in a search snippet; the page would not load, so it is not used. Do not confuse this with the separate Cold Spring lookout in the St. Joe-Clearwater region on idahofirelookouts.com (46.786, -115.304), which is a different site.
